articles.title: Epson RapidReceipt RR-600W Document Scanner Named a Good Housekeeping 2026 Cleaning Awards Winner
articles.mainIdea: Epson RapidReceipt RR-600W Document Scanner Named a Good Housekeeping 2026 Cleaning Awards Winner
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Epson RapidReceipt RR-600W Document Scanner Named a Good Housekeeping 2026 Cleaning Awards Winner. Epson today announced its RapidReceipt® RR-600W Wireless Receipt and Document Scanner was selected as a winner in Good Housekeeping's 2026 Cleaning Awards. The full list of awards can be found on www.goodhousekeeping.com/cleaningawards2026. Related tickers mentioned: SEKEF, SEKEY.
